entry.summary: RT The Long View While I can understand why people don’t like Trump’s strong arm methods, I don’t get the wholesale disdain for tariffs. The US has a boatload of protections (workers rights, environmental regulations, financial reporting requirements, payroll taxes, social benefits, building codes, etc). Why on earth would you hold US workers to these standards but let goods in from overseas that don’t meet these criteria? Especially when they also impose tariffs and trade barriers on our exports. I’m all for letting the cheapest workers do the job it but level the playing field. Don’t tie our workers hands and guarantee they are perpetually uncompetitive.
